 Deni Avdija scores 24 points as Portland suffers first loss of NBA season
 ynet | Print Find an error? Report us The Portland Trail Blazers' perfect start came to an end as they suffered their first loss of the season, falling 124-103 to the Memphis Grizzlies. Deni Avdija delivered an impressive individual performance with 24 points, 9 rebounds and 7 assists, but couldn't prevent a painful defeat against the Grizzlies, who handed them their first loss after three consecutive wins.
